author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, sprite, and background work
content: HIRING. LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios is opening opportunities for freelance artists to collaborate on upcoming projects. Seeking artists skilled in: Character Design & Illustration; Character Sprites; Background & Environment Art; Webtoon / Comic Artwork; Game & Digital Art Assets; other illustration and visual development. Qualifications: strong portfolio and drawing fundamentals; ability to follow art direction or adapt to visual styles; solid anatomy, composition, and color; meet project deadlines; accept feedback and revisions; professional communication and reliable work ethic. How to apply: send portfolio and a short introduction to avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com. Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Your Name]. Also include artwork types, usual art style, availability, and freelance rate. Selected artists will be contacted for upcoming freelance collaborations with Avetetsuya Studios.
